alternativeExplanations.title: Two pieces of one whole
steps: Picture a bar exactly 1 unit long, split into a sin² piece and a cos² piece.
The sin² piece takes 0.36 of the bar, so the cos² piece must fill the rest: 1 − 0.36 = 0.64.

alternativeExplanations.title: Check with the triangle
steps: sin² θ = 0.36 means sin θ = 0.6, so the up leg is 0.6 and the slanted side is 1.
Pythagoras: 0.6² + b² = 1², so b² = 1 − 0.36 = 0.64 (and cos θ = 0.8).
